citations.quote: Name: Heimerdinger. Official role tags: Mage, Support.
Whenever a rocket hits an enemy champion, nearby turrets gain some beam charge.
If the grenade hits an enemy champion, nearby turrets gain full beam charge.

core_mechanics.summary: Rocket and grenade champion hits charge nearby turret beams.

cards.purpose: Recognize Heimerdinger's damage focus and turret-centered fighting pattern.
cards.title: Heimerdinger

citations.quote: Heimerdinger gains bonus movement speed while near allied towers and turrets he deploys.

core_mechanics.summary: Gains movement speed near allied towers and his deployed turrets.

citations.quote: The recharge rate of H-28G Evolution Turret is affected by ability haste.
Heimerdinger periodically stocks a Turret Kit charge, up to a maximum of 3.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Turret Kit recharge and stored charges are important availability topics; ability haste affects recharge.

citations.quote: Heimerdinger deploys a rapid-fire turret that deals magic damage to his target, or a nearby enemy.
The turret has a secondary beam attack that charges up over time, which deals magic damage to enemies hit.

core_mechanics.summary: Deploys a magic-damage turret with rapid attacks and a charging beam.

citations.quote: The turret will become dormant while he leaves it alone.
which lasts until destroyed

core_mechanics.summary: Basic turrets persist until destroyed and become dormant when left alone.

citations.quote: Heimerdinger instead deploys a slow-fire turret that attacks a nearby enemy champion, dealing magic damage and slowing nearby enemies.

core_mechanics.summary: The upgraded turret fires slowly and slows nearby enemies.

cards.purpose: Recognize basic turret coverage and the upgraded turret's slowing threat.
cards.title: H-28G Evolution Turret

citations.quote: Enemies can be hit by multiple rockets, but receive less damage from ones beyond the first.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Additional basic rockets hitting the same enemy deal reduced damage.

citations.quote: Heimerdinger fires a wave of rockets that converge to the target location and fan beyond it to max range, each dealing magic damage to the first enemy hit.

core_mechanics.summary: Rockets converge, fan beyond the target location, and hit the first enemy in their path.

citations.quote: Whenever a rocket hits an enemy champion, nearby turrets gain some beam charge.

core_mechanics.summary: Champion hits charge nearby turret beams.

citations.quote: Heimerdinger unleashes 4 waves of 5 rockets in quick succession that converge upon the target location.

core_mechanics.summary: The upgrade fires repeated rocket waves.

cards.purpose: Recognize rocket trajectories, turret synergy, and the extended upgraded barrage.
cards.title: Hextech Micro-Rockets

citations.quote: Heimerdinger lobs a grenade to the target location that deals magic damage and slows nearby enemies. Enemies hit at the epicenter are also stunned.

core_mechanics.summary: Area magic damage and slow, with a center stun.

citations.quote: If the grenade hits an enemy champion, nearby turrets gain full beam charge.

core_mechanics.summary: Champion hits fully charge nearby turret beams.

citations.quote: The grenade explodes upon landing each time
Enemy champions can only be damaged once per cast, but can be slowed and stunned multiple times if circumstances permit.

core_mechanics.summary: The bouncing upgrade can repeatedly apply crowd control, but damages each champion only once per cast.

cards.purpose: Recognize the center stun, beam-charge threat, and upgraded bounce path.
cards.title: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade

citations.quote: consuming the empowerment upon cast and placing UPGRADE!!! on full cooldown
can be toggled off to remove the empowerment and place the ability on its static cooldown

advanced_exceptions.summary: Consuming empowerment starts the full ultimate cooldown; canceling empowerment uses a separate static cooldown.

citations.quote: UPGRADE!!! can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The ultimate can be activated while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

citations.quote: Heimerdinger empowers his next basic ability for an additional effect, consuming the empowerment upon cast

core_mechanics.summary: Empowers the next basic ability and consumes empowerment on cast.

citations.quote: These empowered abilities have the same cooldowns as their basic forms, deal modified damage, and do not have a mana cost.

core_mechanics.summary: Empowered spells have modified damage, no mana cost, and the basic forms' cooldowns.

cards.purpose: Recognize the ultimate as a toggle that empowers a basic spell.

The upgraded turret's practical threat is taught with Q; recharge details remain metadata.

summary: An overview and primary ability cards teach turret coverage, beam-charge interactions, positional movement speed, and ultimate empowerment. Upgraded spell variants are merged into their corresponding basic ability cards.
